summary: A four-track groovebox firmware based on SLOOP and Felucca, with three synth parts and a drum machine, and an "Event Tape" for rearranging recorded sequencer events into songs.
features: Event Tape copies, lifts and drops notes, hits and locks; not audio
17 engines and 189 factory sounds, including SWARM, PULSE, FM4 and CLOUD
Up to 64 steps with chords, ratchets, p-locks and fill conditions
Synth parts share 8 voices in total
MIDI clock in and out, MIDI Learn, controller mode, USB audio
Bluetooth only in a separate build, which drops some built-in samples

headings: make a loop, then move its events
what makes orbit its own instrument
sounds replaced in the bluetooth build
